reviewRouting.title: Review routing
reviewRouting.intro: A task that moves to review with no reviewer gets one automatically: the least loaded agent of the reviewer roles, never the task's author or assignee. With no reviewer available, the task is signalled on the attention desk. A review without a verdict past the set hours is signalled and moved to another reviewer. Changes apply without a restart.
reviewRouting.noCompany: Select a company to edit its review routing.
reviewRouting.rolesHint: Caste keys of the agents that may review, separated by commas.
reviewRouting.maxLoadHint: A reviewer already holding this many tasks in flight (in progress + in review) is not picked.
reviewRouting.maxLoadInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
reviewRouting.hoursHint: Hours in review without a verdict before the task is signalled and moved to another reviewer. 0 — never.
reviewRouting.hoursInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 2160.
reviewRouting.prWatchIntro: A green pull request gets a review task from an event instead of a standing split task, so reviews stop blocking each other.
reviewRouting.prWatchEnabledLabel: Create review tasks for green pull requests
reviewRouting.prRepositoriesHint: One entry per line as owner/repo. Leave empty to watch every repository the board sees.
reviewRouting.prRepositoriesInvalid: Each entry must look like owner/repo.
reviewRouting.prMaxOpenHint: A reviewer already holding this many open pull-request reviews is not picked.
reviewRouting.prMaxOpenInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
reviewRouting.prMaxNewHint: Review tasks one polling pass assigns at most.
reviewRouting.prMaxNewInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
reviewRouting.prPollIntervalHint: How often the board checks pull requests for a review.
reviewRouting.prPollIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 15 to 3600.
reviewRouting.stewardIntro: The steward merges a pull request whose review passed, so an approved review does not wait for a person.
reviewRouting.stewardRolesHint: Caste keys of the agents that may merge, separated by commas.
reviewRouting.stewardMaxMergesHint: Merges one steward performs in one pass.
reviewRouting.stewardMaxMergesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.

foraging.title: Foraging
foraging.intro: Approved sources per role. Each pass compares a source with its previous snapshot; a difference becomes a finding, and a finding becomes a skill candidate through the skill lifecycle.
foraging.selectOrganization: Select an organization to view its foraging sources.
foraging.disabledNote: Periodic foraging is off on this instance, so no pass runs on its own. The registry below is still editable; ask the operator to switch the sweep on.

idleGate.title: Idle only
idleGate.description: A pass reads a role's sources only while the role is idle: its queue holds no unassigned open task and one of its agents is free. Working tasks always come first.
idleGate.label: Run passes only while the role is idle
idleGate.nextPass: The rule is read on every pass, so a switch applies to the next pass — no restart.

settings.authenticatedPrivateMode: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
settings.censorUsernameHint: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
settings.keyboardShortcutsHint: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
settings.backupRetentionHint: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
settings.keepLastBackupOnlyHint: Only the most recent backup is kept. The daily, weekly and monthly presets are ignored while this mode is on.
settings.keepLastBackupOnlyRisk: Older backups are deleted only after the new dump passes verification. If the new dump is broken, the older backups stay in place, so nothing is lost — but the disk space is not freed either.
settings.feedbackSharingHint: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
